overview: A service that ingests transactions from multiple sources and produces a reconciled ledger with an audit trail.
architecture: Modular Python core with a pure-function matching engine, a pluggable source adapter layer, and a thin API surface.
requirements: Match transactions across two sources by amount and date
Flag unmatched transactions on both sides
Produce a summary with matched/unmatched counts
non_functional: 100% unit-test coverage of the matching engine
